card-weekly-net-sales-decline-e4f53a37.decision_guidance: Notify the business destination team-1ad71a8723aa9325e8c1 when net sales declines by at least 10% versus the prior complete reporting week. Otherwise ignore. If metric definitions are missing or postings/population coverage are incomplete, classify as insufficient_data and route to data destination team-66fa81ad827deebeb98f. Do not infer causation; include supported accounting decomposition and driver facts, including web contribution, when available.
card-weekly-net-sales-decline-e4f53a37.follow_up_guidance: Use only current-period evidence and the validated previous complete reporting week comparison. Distinguish observations, accounting decompositions, associations, hypotheses, and causal claims. Do not fill missing populations with zero or claim unavailable facts.
